title: 36 Hours in Brooklyn
abstract: Summer in Brooklyn rewards spontaneity, so this packed guide requires no restaurant reservations or advance planning.

title: 36 Hours in Ljubljana, Slovenia
abstract: Stroll along the river, explore a contemporary art scene and admire panoramic views in this scenic Central European capital.

title: 36 Hours in Portland, Maine
abstract: Find your favorite lobster shack, take a ferry to an island and linger in bookstores over a weekend in this classic New England destination.

title: 36 Hours in Dublin
abstract: Explore a whiskey renaissance, tour the country’s oldest public library and brave a brisk sea dip in the Irish capital.
